title: Module builder: author a form with sample pre-fill + Health Canada review
walkthrough:
You start on "Your product dossiers", under a top bar branded "ANDS Studio" with chips for "Help", "Portfolio", "Registry", "Correspondence" and "Guided journey →". Each dossier is a tile showing its ID, product name, a progress bar, and a chip reading either "Ready to file" or a count like "2/5 modules". Clicking a tile opens the dossier at Module 1. (Creating a new one requires a Dossier ID in a specific format — "Dossier ID must be one letter + 6–7 digits (e.g. e123456)" — or you click "No ID yet? Start with a placeholder →".)

Inside, the top bar shows module tabs M1–M5 with status glyphs, plus "Application Viewer", "Audit", "Portfolio" and "Journey" chips. The workspace is three columns: a left section tree with per-section glyphs (○ / ◐ / ✓) and a collapsed "Not required for this generic (N)" list; a center panel; and a right rail with module progress ("3/7 required sections complete") and readiness flags "Documents", "Fee", "Valid eCTD".

Selecting a section shows an eyebrow line ("Module 1 · Section 1.2.5 · required"), the section title, its purpose, and a teach box "What Health Canada needs here" with format notes and a "Health Canada guidance ↗" link. A tab bar offers "⬆ Upload", "✦ Author in-app", and "⊘ Mark N/A".

Choosing "✦ Author in-app" opens a form (for AI-eligible sections, a mode toggle "💬 Draft with AI" / "✦ Sample & edit" appears first). A note explains: "Pre-filled with a realistic sample from your dossier — edit every field to your product, then author. Fields marked sample are worked examples to replace." Fields carry regulatory labels like "Drug product", "Canadian Reference Product (brand)", "s.5 statement (per patent)" and "AUC 90% CI"; sample-sourced ones show a small "sample" tag. You edit them, then click "Author {section title} →" (it reads "Authoring…" while busy), or run a check first via the ghost button "Review vs Health Canada".

Either way, a review panel appears: "Health Canada review:" followed by "no blocking content gaps." on pass, or a count like "2 to fix, 1 to check." with a bulleted list of findings, each with a suggested edit and an "HC guidance ↗" link. The authored document lists above the tabs with filename, size, md5 fragment, a provenance chip ("authored in-app", "uploaded", or "AI-assisted — review before filing"), and a "Download" link. The right rail's progress and the section-tree glyph update to reflect completion.
